How It Works

  • Auto-syncs from portal

    Open NIET ERP and the extension reads your attendance automatically.

  • On-page badges

    Status badges appear above your attendance table showing bunkable classes.

  • Real schedule dates

    Uses actual portal dates for leave planning, not just weekly timetable.

  • Private by design

    All data stays in your browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
